args.name: Build a small branch windbreak
args.function: Learn a feasible method for constructing a stable, modest branch windbreak beside an outdoor resting place, with an open woven form if feasible.
args.conditions: I am outdoors, with fallen-branch sources visible nearby. I have not gathered or tested branches and know no construction method. Avoid obstructing people or damaging living trees.
args.inputs: Potential fallen branches gathered locally. Identify any other necessary materials, suitable site requirements, and actual quantities before construction.
args.costs: Unknown. Specify realistic materials, effort, learning time, and construction time. I do not yet possess building materials or personal construction mastery.
args.effects: Enable actual construction only after learning and acquiring sufficient materials. Stability and any wind reduction must follow real construction and conditions; requesting alone creates no shelter or happiness.

candidates.function: Plant one owned food unit from a living plant in a small hand-prepared soil plot, where it may establish as a new plant under the existing plant rules; inspect plots or plant sources; end unfinished planting.
candidates.costs: Study: 3 rounds. Plant: inputStackId names one whole owned, untreated, unspoiled food unit (quantity 1) gathered from a living plant; x, y a 0.25 m plot within reach on ordinary meadow soil (.), waterlogging at most 0.1, soil moisture 0.3-1.2, 0.6 m clear of objects and people, with fewer than 3 plants of that food within 5 m. Two paid rounds of 1.5 energy: prepare the site, then transfer the unit; the action continues itself, and plant resumes paused work after rechecking reach, site, unit and energy. Inspect: target a plot or plant source in reach; one round, 0.2 energy (baseline probe observation). End: stops unfinished planting; one round, no energy. Tend is refused at no cost: no water, fertilizer or other treatment exists yet. Harvest uses gather. No tool, water or seed is provided.
candidates.effects: Preparing keeps the unit carried, owned and ageing. Transfer moves it, with origin and age, into the plot, where it cannot be eaten or used; the plot becomes a propagule exactly like a naturally dispersed one. It gains establishment only from actual temperature, light, soil moisture and season, so cold, darkness or drought stall it; if the buried unit spoils first, the plot dies. On establishing, the unit becomes a new plant with no stock and a ceiling of at most 4, regrowing under the natural rule, harvested by anyone through gather; nothing is copied or guaranteed. Inspect records only visible stage, stock, soil and weather as an unverified personal record. An unworked round pauses; low energy, leaving reach or a changed site pause without charge; a lost or spoiled unit stops the work. End, or death, before transfer returns the unit once (where the person died); a transferred unit stays planted. No reward or refund.

response.text: {"queries":[],"result_json":"{\"reviews\":[{\"actor\":\"sol\",\"decision\":\"develop\",\"ability\":null,\"reason\":\"Develop a general branch-screen construction operation in the current-conversation handoff. The supplied related-capability searches found gathering, observation and planting, not an equivalent construction function. Reuse gather (base:gather:1; forest.gather, foundation-forest@1) for material acquisition and probe (open-baseline:probe:1; open.probe, foundation-open@1) for baseline observations; record those dependencies rather than claiming their reinvention. Neither supplies structural assembly. Fallen-branch sources are observed, but usable dimensions, flexibility, ground suitability and wind are not established. Development and review do not advance time or give Sol materials, learning or a finished screen.\",\"specification\":\"Implement Construct branch screen as a general operation with modes assess, assemble, inspect, repair and dismantle, parameterized by site coordinates, orientation, explicit owned input-stack IDs and quantities, or an existing project/structure ID. Applicable actors learn it independently. Minimum supported product is an unroofed, approximately 0.9 m wide and 0.4–0.45 m high porous woven branch screen; no shelter, roof, fire protection or storm resistance is implied. Use a deterministic implementation of suitability, work, stability, damage and exposure, not repeated model judgments. Dependencies are actual spatial reach/occupancy, inventory transfers, material properties, ground resistance and measured weather/exposure. If these mechanisms are missing, implement the necessary bounded checks in this handoff; never substitute successful construction for unavailable evidence.\\nMaterial recipe: three sound naturally pointed upright pieces about 0.65–0.75 m long and 2–3 cm thick, inserted at least 0.25 m into suitable soil at approximately 0, 0.45 and 0.9 m along the screen, plus eight sound flexible rods about 1.0–1.2 m long and 1–2 cm thick. Alternate weaving around the three uprights, retaining ends and leaving distributed openings rather than making a solid wall. Confirm actual fit, spring-back and retention during assembly. These are eleven qualifying pieces, not automatically eleven resource units: preserve actual inventory quantities and mass, and establish how existing branch units map to pieces before committing a recipe. No cutting, sharpening, cord, tools, stones or water are supplied or assumed. No other material is required for this version if hand insertion and weaving genuinely work. If suitable pieces or soil are unavailable, assess records the measured deficiency and permits only the feasible ground/support trial, not a completed windbreak.\\nSite: a reachable, clear footprint at least 1.2 by 0.6 m beside, not across, the resting location; no occupied path, entrance, person, protected vegetation or living-tree attachment. Check lawful access under existing permissions rather than granting permission. Ground must admit hand insertion and then retain the posts without loose, saturated or rocky failure. Maintain a clear resting area beyond the possible fall footprint. Orient using actual local wind observations; do not assume a prevailing direction. Initial assess takes one round and 0.2 energy for visible conditions, using probe-compatible observation. A physical support trial takes one round and 0.5 energy and requires one suitable owned post. Record actual insertion, resistance and any damage; an intact post remains recoverable, and any breakage becomes tracked damaged material. It does not consume the baseline probe sample automatically or create a support.\\nAcquisition uses gather with exact visible source IDs, for example start-2-branches, forest-branch-0, canopy-41 or canopy-69, subject to current stock, reach and the full gather contract. Do not reserve or reveal unobserved stock. Gather costs 2 energy per transferred resource unit and one round per execution. Eleven qualifying one-unit pieces would therefore cost 22 energy, plus actual travel and handling; suitability is not guaranteed. Navigation retains navigate/base:navigate:1 travel costs. Sol owns berries, not construction inputs, and has energy 40; do not automatically gather, spend berries or assume enough energy for every stage without rest.\\nAfter learning and a valid trial, assemble requires all specified pieces owned and in reach. Allocate them once to a visible project with exact source-stack provenance; subtract them from freely usable inventory without duplicating material. Eight paid work rounds at 1.5 energy each: two rounds seating and checking uprights, four weaving and retaining rods, one gap/alignment correction and one stability check. Each stage records installed pieces and observable progress. These are active-work minima; failed fit, additional gathering, travel or waiting takes real additional time. Require sufficient energy before each paid round. Perform a low-force hand stability check and record displacement and loose components against a coded acceptance threshold appropriate to the declared dimensions and actual ground/material properties. Completion requires every connection and support passing; a failed check leaves an incomplete or unstable structure, not success. No guaranteed wind-reduction percentage is assigned.\\nLeaving reach, insufficient energy, occupancy changes or an invalid site pauses before further work and without additional charge. Resume by project ID after rechecking site, inputs, integrity and energy; retain completed work and costs. Cancel stops queued work, returns uninstalled surviving escrow once, and leaves installed pieces as an explicitly incomplete physical project until dismantled. Death stops work; uninstalled escrow becomes recoverable material at the work/death location under existing ownership/death rules, while installed material remains in place. Never refund spent time or energy. Global pauses preserve progress and costs. Prevent concurrent use of allocated material and double returns.\\nInspect takes one reachable round and 0.2 energy and reports only observable integrity, gaps and local exposure. Repair specifies damaged components and owned replacements; one removal and one fitting round per replaced piece, each 1.5 energy, followed by the one-round 1.5-energy stability check. Reuse intact components; preserve removed broken material as debris with its remaining mass and properties. Dismantle takes one round per three installed pieces, rounded up, at 1 energy per round; recover only actually surviving pieces, decrementing the structure as each group is removed. No energy, time or damage refund.\\nA completed screen persists physically without continued work but is checked by ongoing weather, collision and decay rules. Its solids affect passage only at actual occupied geometry. Wind effects apply only to reachable occupied locations in its small leeward footprint, using current wind direction/speed, height, porosity and integrity; absent a credible local exposure calculation, show an unverified screen and allow measured exposure comparison, not a fabricated shelter bonus. No roof, rainproofing, heating or food is produced. Wind shifts remove coverage; breakage or loosened posts reduce or end it immediately and can leave fallen material. Inspection is advisable after gusts and before use; there is no automatic repair or recurring material charge without work. Use rest (base:rest:1; forest.rest, foundation-forest@1) unchanged unless its implemented facility/exposure rules actually recognize this structure; never stack duplicate rest or comfort bonuses.\",\"learning\":4,\"experienceReview\":\"Four individual study rounds teach the implemented method, not construction mastery; requests, review, reading the contract and study grant no pleasure or satisfaction. Default construction and inspection experience payout is zero. A verified new finding from a real material, ground or exposure trial, including informative failure, may use an existing bounded information-gain rule if applicable, deduplicated by fact and conditions; no new reward currency or account edits are authorized. Familiar successful maintenance can qualify for modest benefit only through an existing coded personal-practice rule with amount, cap, decay and cooldown; otherwise award none. Actual resting comfort requires the actor to occupy the measured protected location under applicable conditions, deduplicates overlapping protection and is capped at 10 total physical comfort. It does not reduce basic nutritional need or independently alter rest recovery, protected reward accounts, budget, goals or permissions. Other actors are neither recruited nor credited automatically; each must communicate and act independently.\",\"visualReview\":\"Emit observable events for trial results, material allocation, completed work stages, pause/resume, failed checks, completion, damage, repair and dismantling. Reusable visual metadata includes project/structure ID, operation type, position, orientation, measured width/height, porosity, installed-piece geometry, material appearance, stage, integrity and status: planned, in-progress, unstable, complete, damaged or dismantled. A plan is only a non-solid outline; installed pieces appear only after paid work and transfer. Render the woven screen only to actual completion, never show shelter or success effects on a failed trial or incomplete assembly, and never visualize unmeasured wind reduction as fact. Exposure indicators require actual localized measurements and current conditions. Reuse existing material, project and event rendering components where available and record that reuse in implementation.\"}]}"}
